scenes.title: Home to Room Eight
scenes.summary: After settling the retired mapmaker happily at table one under the shade tree, Nour, Mazen, and Rami step to the front desk to fetch the green guest book and brass key number 8.

scenes.title: Slices of Summer Cake
scenes.summary: At the bustling café counter, Salma plates generous slices of berry-and-almond cake while Ziad and Nour report that the honoured guest called it identical to thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Four-Hand Duet
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Suad and Rami perform their joyful four-hand piano duet through the open shutters to warm applause from all twenty-eight courtyard seats.

scenes.title: The Illustrated Map Gift
scenes.summary: Under the shade tree, Nour reads the retired mapmaker's warm written toast aloud while Mazen and Salma unveil his gift: a framed watercolour map of Jasmine Street with Jasmine Courtyard House glowing at its centre.

scenes.title: A New Tin for Tomorrow
scenes.summary: As early evening settles in, Tariq surprises Nour inside Room 9 with a brand-new brass-rimmed tin box and waxed linen to seal a new time capsule for thirty summers ahead.

scenes.title: Four Small Keepsakes
scenes.summary: Around the Room 9 table, Salma, Suad, and Ziad place the complete laminated berry-cake recipe, the signed waltz sheet, wooden clothespin number 9, and a fresh group sketch into the new tin.

scenes.title: Back Under the Third Stone
scenes.summary: Under twenty-four glowing lanterns at twilight, Tariq, Mazen, and Nour lower the new waxed-cloth capsule into the brick pocket beneath the third flagstone north of the shade tree.

scenes.title: The Autumn Festival Envelope
scenes.summary: Hanging the framed watercolour map beside the front desk at nine in the evening, Nour and Mazen discover an official municipal envelope from Ziad inviting Jasmine Courtyard House into the autumn Historic Courtyard Festival.
